blocks.text: Where will the churches be standing if the translation should take place today? Where would you be? It is going to take a special type of material to go up with the Lord in the translation. We are in the preparation time. Who is ready? Qualification means being prepared. Behold, the bride makes herself ready. The Qualifications:
The elect will love the truth despite their shortcomings. The truth will transform the elect.
Those who love not the truth will perish (2 Thessalonians 2: 10).
There is one true doctrine—the Lord Jesus Christ and His words in
the New Testament and the Old Testament. That is the doctrine of the Lord Jesus Christ. The real truth is hated. It was nailed to the cross.
Loyalty—the elect will be loyal to what God says. Like Abraham, Enoch and the apostles, they will be faithful witnesses. They will believe and tell the truth.
The elect will not be ashamed. They will be watching and praying. They will not reject the word of God. There is no fault in the Word.
The elect believe in miracles and in the power of the spirit. They believe in true salvation. They will have the oil of anointing to work the word. The word will transform the elect.

The elect will love the Lord with the mind, soul, heart and body. The organizations and Pentecostals may love Him in one area only, but the elect will reach the Lord in all areas, mind, soul, heart and body. Honor and praise must be present. The elect will not sour on the word of God.

Repentance and confession—Daniel repented and confessed when there was found no error in him. The angel had to say, “O Daniel, thou are greatly beloved.” How much more should the church confess and repent today? The elect will confess their shortcomings. This is one of the signs of great revival.

The elect will believe in Jesus, the eternal God, in three manifestations of the same spirit. They will believe in water baptism in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ as in the Book of Acts. Nowhere did the apostles baptize in the name of the father, son and holy spirit.

Patience—Be patient unto the coming of the Lord (James 5: 7). With each outpouring, the church thought the Lord was coming. Many will be called but few will be chosen. Patience is running out, but this is when it is needed, the time when the Lord will do great things for His people. The Lord will shake everything loose that is not nailed to Him. Along with patience, longsuffering--fruit of the holy spirit--must be present.
Divine love must be in the body of Christ. We are in short supply of divine love. We must carry the burden of the Lord for souls, not the burden of the world.

Forgiveness is the foundation of the gospel and the foundation of the Lord’s coming. People are in short supply of it. We must forgive in order to be forgiven. Also, we must show compassion to the people of God. We need these qualifications to get out of here.

The elect will believe in the fruit and the gifts of the Holy Spirit. If you eat enough proper fruits, you should not be constipated. The church is constipated. It is not getting enough fruit of the spirit. With enough fruit and divine love, the church will be clean.

There should be no guile, gall or fraud in the body of Christ. You should not cheat your brother. The elect will be honest. There should be no gossip. Each of us will give account. Talk more about the right things instead of the wrong things. If you don’t have the facts, don’t say anything. Talk about the word of God and the coming of the Lord, not about yourself. Give the Lord time and credit. Gossip that lies and hates is a No, No, to the Lord.

The elect believe that there is a heaven and a paradise, an eternal home for the elect. Jesus Christ is the God of the heaven of heavens. Also, believe that there is a hell for those that reject Jesus Christ. The negative spirits will go to hell.

The elect believe that there are demon powers and satanic forces. Also, they believe that there are angels and principalities of God. As the power becomes strong to bring the elect to the headstone, Satan will do everything to attack the elect of God, but he is defeated. As Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so the devil will attack the true elect, but the Lord will go past the fourth dimension to pull us away, our bodies will be changed and we are out of here.

The elect will have live faith, not dead faith. They will have action faith, not dormant faith. The Lord said, “…When the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth” (Luke 18: 8)? The elect will have working faith that is produced by the word of God.

The elect believe in predestination (Ephesians 1: 4 -5). The elect believe that predestination works with the word of God. They believe that by predestination, there is a Gentile bride, that the Lord will take out of here and that 144,000 Jews are predestinated to be protected during the great tribulation. The elect believe in providence.

Witnessing—“Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord” (Isaiah 43: 10). He will appear to those that love His appearing. Expectation is one of the qualifications. You will witness that He is coming very soon. The urgency must be there.
Holiness and righteousness must be present in the elect, the kind that is born full of faith. There must be divine love. There should be no self-righteousness.

The elect will believe in helping to support the true gospel. Be a good steward (Malachi 3: 8 – 11). They will believe in getting behind the work of God. Joy and cheerfulness (in giving) are qualifications.

Prophecy—the elect will believe in prophecy for guidance, revelation, power and prophetic timing. The bible is full of prophecy from Genesis to Revelation. “The testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy” (Revelation 19: 10).

The elect will believe in and talk about the translation. Also, they will talk about the great tribulation, the antichrist and the mark of the beast. They will not shove these matters under the rug. The elect can take the whole word of God. Be ye also ready. Some got ready first—the midnight criers. The elect will walk in the fourth dimension before they leave. The dead in Christ will rise and walk among us. We will be caught up together. The church is not quite ready yet, but it is getting together and will be ready through persecution. Persecution and world-wide crises will tell the elect to shape up. Also, nature will be a great preacher. In an hour you think not, go ye out to meet Him. Miracles beyond imagination will take place. A quick work will He do among His people. The elect will love the word more than ever. It will mean life to them. I will come again, saith the Lord. Nothing can stop it. May the spirit of God keep you and give you the power to get out of here. Amen. COMFORT ONE ANOTHER WITH THESE WORDS.
